'''''Hitman 3'''''{{efn|Stylized as '''''Hitman III'''''; retitled '''''Hitman: World of Assassination''''' in 2023}} is a 2021 [[stealth game]] developed and published by [[IO Interactive]]. It is the eighth main installment in the ''[[Hitman (franchise)|Hitman]]'' video game series, the sequel to 2018's ''[[Hitman 2 (2018 video game)|Hitman 2]]'', and the third game in the ''World of Assassination'' trilogy. Concluding the story arc started in 2016's ''[[Hitman (2016 video game)|Hitman]]'', the game follows [[genetically engineered]] assassin [[Agent 47]] and his allies as they hunt down the leaders of the secretive organization Providence, which controls global affairs and was partially responsible for 47's creation and upbringing. Like its two predecessors, the game is structured around six levels, five of which are large [[Sandbox game|sandbox]] locations that players can freely explore to find opportunities to eliminate their targets. 

The base game features six locations: [[Dubai]], [[Dartmoor]], [[Berlin]], [[Chongqing]], [[Mendoza, Argentina|Mendoza]], and the [[Carpathian Mountains]] in [[Romania]]. A post-launch update introduced a new fictional island location set in the [[Andaman Sea]]. IO Interactive wanted the game to be more story-driven. As a result, ''Hitman 3'' has a more mature and serious tone. The team was more willing to experiment with its mission design, shaking up the existing gameplay loop and realizing ideas that they had been unable or afraid to implement in the past, such as framing assassination opportunities within a [[murder-mystery]] in the Dartmoor level. While gameplay is largely similar to its predecessor, developers were inspired by [[immersive sim]] games, adding many elements from the genre such as an emphasis on engaging with the world for intel, branching level stories with multiple possible outcomes, and prevalent opportunities to make use of the environment's [[emergent gameplay]].

''Hitman 3'', the first game to be self-published by IO Interactive after becoming an independent studio, was first released worldwide for [[PlayStation 4]], [[PlayStation 5]], [[Windows]], [[Xbox One]], [[Xbox Series X/S]], [[Google Stadia|Stadia]], and [[Nintendo Switch]] (via [[cloud gaming]]) in January 2021. It received positive reviews, with praise for its level design and atmosphere, stealth mechanics, and 47's abilities. Some critics called it the best entry in the series; the game has been called one of the greatest stealth games of all time. ''Hitman 3'' was the series' most commercially successful title, and has been extensively supported by IO with several releases of [[downloadable content]] and free updates. In January 2023, IO rebranded ''Hitman 3'' as '''''Hitman: World of Assassination''''', shifting the game into a [[Live service game|live-service]] format with the contents of the previous two ''Hitman'' games becoming available to ''Hitman 3'' owners for free. '''''Hitman 3 VR: Reloaded''''', a standalone edition of the game's VR mode featuring only the main ''Hitman 3'' campaign, was released for [[Meta Quest 3]] by XR Games in September 2024.

==Gameplay==
[[File: Hitman 3 screenshot.jpg|thumb|left|The player explores the Burj al-Ghazali / the Sceptre in [[Dubai]], a fictional skyscraper inspired by the [[Burj Khalifa]], in the game's first mission "On Top of the World".]]

Like its predecessors, ''Hitman 3'' is a [[stealth game]] played from a [[third-person perspective]], in which players once again assume control of assassin [[Agent 47]]. 47 travels to various locations and carries out contracted assassinations, continuing the story of the last two games. The base game features six new locations: [[Dubai]], [[Dartmoor]], [[Berlin]], [[Chongqing]], [[Mendoza Province|Mendoza]], and the [[Carpathian Mountains]] in [[Romania]].<ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://egmnow.com/hitman-3-reveals-the-rest-of-its-mission-locations/|title=Hitman 3 reveals the rest of its mission locations|first=Michael|last=Goroff|magazine=[[Electronic Gaming Monthly]]|date=11 January 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=31 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230331033125/https://egmnow.com/hitman-3-reveals-the-rest-of-its-mission-locations/|url-status=live}}</ref> A seventh map, a fictional island in the [[Andaman Sea]] called Ambrose Island, was added for free on 26 July 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/hitman-3s-new-ambrose-island-map-dated-with-location-reveal-trailer/|title=Hitman 3's new Ambrose Island map dated with location reveal trailer|first=Tom|last=Ivan|work=Video Games Chronicle|date=8 July 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=22 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230322093844/https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/hitman-3s-new-ambrose-island-map-dated-with-location-reveal-trailer/|url-status=live}}</ref> Owners of ''Hitman'' or ''Hitman 2'' are able to import maps, levels, and their progress into ''Hitman 3''. Maps from the older games incorporate the new gameplay changes featured in ''Hitman 3''.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Chalk |first=Andy |date=11 June 2020 |title=Hitman 3 is coming in January |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/hitman-3-is-coming-in-january/ |url-status=live |magazine=[[PC Gamer]] |language=en-US |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200611220258/https://www.pcgamer.com/hitman-3-is-coming-in-january/ |archive-date=11 June 2020 |access-date=11 June 2020}}</ref> PC and PlayStation players can play the game in [[first-person perspective|first-person]] with a [[virtual reality]] headset.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.engadget.com/hitman-3-ps-vr-ps4-ps5-playstation-stream-205630456.html|title='Hitman 3' will include first-person assassinations on PSVR|first=Jessica|last=Conditt|work=[[Engadget]]|date=6 August 2020|access-date=6 August 2023|archive-date=6 August 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230806033625/https://www.engadget.com/hitman-3-ps-vr-ps4-ps5-playstation-stream-205630456.html|url-status=live}}</ref>

As with previous games in the series, each location (with the exception of the Romania mission), is a large, complex sandbox environment that the player can freely explore for infiltration and assassination opportunities.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2020/06/17/hitman-3-arrives-on-xbox-january-2021/|title=Hitman 3 Arrives on Xbox Series X and Xbox One in January 2021|first=Travis|last=Barbour|work=Xbox.com|date=17 June 2020|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=28 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230328101200/https://news.xbox.com/en-us/2020/06/17/hitman-3-arrives-on-xbox-january-2021/|url-status=live}}</ref> Players will gradually discover "persistent shortcuts", creating pathways that can be used in future playthroughs.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-will-give-players-special-shortcuts-through-levels/1100-6485958/|title=Hitman 3 Will Give Players Special Shortcuts Through Levels|first=Aron|last=Gaust|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=6 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=25 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230425064020/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-will-give-players-special-shortcuts-through-levels/1100-6485958/|url-status=live}}</ref> With the exception of the Berlin level,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/the-astonishing-berlin-level-in-hitman-3-is-a-landmark-in-the-series/|title=The Astonishing Berlin Level in 'Hitman 3' Is a Landmark in the Series|first=Cameron|last=Kunzelman|date=2 February 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|work=[[Vice (magazine)|Vice]]|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065558/https://www.vice.com/en/article/88aekv/the-astonishing-berlin-level-in-hitman-3-is-a-landmark-in-the-series|url-status=live}}</ref> players are assigned several assassination targets, which can be highlighted using 47's instinct vision. Instinct vision highlights all relevant items of interest.<ref name="polygon guide">{{cite web|url=https://www.polygon.com/hitman-3-guide-walkthrough/22243227/beginners-guide-tips-tricks|title=Hitman 3 beginner's guide: 8 tips and tricks|first=Samit|last=Sarker|work=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]]|date=21 January 2023|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065538/https://www.polygon.com/hitman-3-guide-walkthrough/22243227/beginners-guide-tips-tricks|url-status=live}}</ref> Using stealth tactics are key to 47's success. 47 can gain access to restricted areas of the game by obtaining a disguise either by incapacitating [[non-player character]]s (NPCs) or by finding it somewhere in the map.<ref name="see through disguise">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.gameinformer.com/2021/01/28/how-to-find-hitmans-most-useful-disguises|title=How To Find Hitman's Most Useful Disguises|first=Blake|last=Hester|magazine=[[Game Informer]]|date=28 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701124031/https://www.gameinformer.com/2021/01/28/how-to-find-hitmans-most-useful-disguises|url-status=live}}</ref><ref name="GI assassin">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.gameinformer.com/feature/2021/01/24/hitman-3-beginners-guide-essential-tips-to-become-a-silent-assassin|title=Hitman 3 Beginner's Guide: Essential Tips To Become A Silent Assassin|first=Alex|last=Van Haken|magazine=[[Game Informer]]|date=24 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065549/https://www.gameinformer.com/feature/2021/01/24/hitman-3-beginners-guide-essential-tips-to-become-a-silent-assassin|url-status=live}}</ref> Eavesdropping on conversations between NPCs can open up new ways for assassinations. Players may encounter several "mission stories" in each level, which serve as a set of guided instructions that reveal opportunities for unconventional assassinations.<ref name="polygon guide"/> To avoid detection, players should avoid performing actions that would be deemed as suspicious, such as crouching or running in the open.<ref name="RB">{{cite web|url=https://www.redbull.com/gb-en/hitman-3-tips-guide|title=Hitman 3 tips and tricks: How to master Agent 47's latest world tour|first=Dom|last=Peppiatt|work=[[Red Bull]]|date=25 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=2 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230702035720/https://www.redbull.com/gb-en/hitman-3-tips-guide|url-status=live}}</ref> The player's disguise may affect what actions a player may perform. For instance, dressing as a guard allows 47 to wander around the map with guns and weapons without drawing attention from other characters.<ref name="RB"/> Some NPCs, called enforcers, can see through the player's disguise.<ref name="see through disguise"/> Guards have several states of alert level. Some may be suspicious of 47, who must attempt to blend in and mingle with the crowd to avoid drawing further attention. If the player is spotted performing an illegal action, 47 may be compromised and guards will begin searching for him. To avoid this, he must incapacitate the witnesses or change his current outfit.<ref name="RB"/>

Each mission starts with a planning phase, allowing 47 to choose what weapons and items to bring with him. After the player completes a level once, they can choose their starting location in the map during this phase.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/en_asia/guides/gaming-guides/hitman-iii-guide-essential-tips-before-playing-the-game-2866911|title='Hitman III' guide: seven essential tips I wish I knew before playing the game|first=Jordan|last=Oloman|work=[[NME]]|date=28 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065539/https://www.nme.com/en_asia/guides/gaming-guides/hitman-iii-guide-essential-tips-before-playing-the-game-2866911|url-status=live}}</ref> Players can use a variety of methods to approach their target. 47 has a wide range of firearms and explosives that he can use to eliminate his targets.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.shacknews.com/cortex/article/2242/my-10-favorite-weapons-and-gadgets-in-hitman-3|title=My 10 favorite weapons and gadgets in Hitman 3|work=[[Shacknews]]|date=17 November 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=3 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230203124345/https://www.shacknews.com/cortex/article/2242/my-10-favorite-weapons-and-gadgets-in-hitman-3|url-status=live}}</ref> Items in the world can be picked up by 47 and used as makeshift weapons. ===Gameplay modes===
In addition to the game's single-player campaign, numerous game modes from previous games return in ''Hitman 3''. Escalation contracts are multi-stage contracts that get harder with each stage. They task players with eliminating targets under specific conditions, such as wearing a particular disguise or using a specific weapon.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/you-need-to-play-hitman-3s-escalation-missions/1100-6486801/|title=You Need To Play Hitman 3's Escalation Missions|first=Michael|last=Higham|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=29 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=11 April 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210411034711/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/you-need-to-play-hitman-3s-escalation-missions/1100-6486801/|url-status=live}}</ref> ''Hitman 3'' features "Elusive Targets", which are time-limited missions that may only be attempted once. Elusive Targets are introduced in the game as regular updates.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-world-of-assassination-to-get-first-new-elusive-target-in-two-years|title=Hitman: World of Assassination to Get First New Elusive Target in Two Years|first=Wesley|last=Yin-Poole|work=[[IGN]]|date=31 July 2023|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=31 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230731175326/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-world-of-assassination-to-get-first-new-elusive-target-in-two-years|url-status=live}}</ref> ''Hitman 3'' introduces "Elusive Target Arcade", which is a permanent feature in the game. In Elusive Target Arcade, players must take down several Elusive Targets consecutively as the difficulty increases from target to target. Failing requires the player to wait 12 hours before attempting again.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-year-two-elusive-target-arcade-freelancer-mode-and-pc-vr-detailed/1100-6499608/|title=Hitman 3 Year Two: Elusive Target Arcade, Freelancer Mode, And PC VR Detailed|first=Darryn|last=Bonthuys|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=13 January 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065602/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-year-two-elusive-target-arcade-freelancer-mode-and-pc-vr-detailed/1100-6499608/|url-status=live}}</ref> The game features Contracts Mode, where a player can select several targets across all maps in the ''World of Assassination'' trilogy, add extra complications like specific kill methods, and share their contracts with other players.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eurogamer.net/you-can-now-play-five-eurogamer-themed-featured-contracts-in-hitman-3|title=You can now play five Eurogamer-themed Featured Contracts in Hitman 3|first=Ian|last=Higton|work=[[Eurogamer]]|date=25 March 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=15 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220415220627/https://www.eurogamer.net/you-can-now-play-five-eurogamer-themed-featured-contracts-in-hitman-3|url-status=live}}</ref>

The [[roguelike]] mode "Freelancer" was introduced in 2023. In this mode, 47 must take down several [[crime syndicate]]s as a freelancer, without the help of the Agency, and players cannot save the game during missions.<ref name="GRadar Freelancer">{{cite web|url=https://www.gamesradar.com/hitman-freelancer-tips/|title=8 Hitman Freelancer tips to take down the Syndicates|first=Iain|last=Wilson|work=[[GamesRadar]]|date=4 February 2023|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=28 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230528032742/https://www.gamesradar.com/hitman-freelancer-tips/|url-status=live}}</ref> Players must eliminate four web|url=https://gamingbolt.com/hitman-3-freelancer-overview-video-details-syndicates-showdowns-safehouse-and-more|title=Hitman 3: Freelancer Overview Video Details Syndicates, Showdowns, Safehouse, player's contract, the assassination conditions, and the player's starting location are randomly generated.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/features/gaming-features/hitman-freelancer-is-hitman-at-its-very-best-3398456|title='Hitman Freelancer' is 'Hitman' at its very best|first=Jake|last=Tucker|work=[[NME]]|date=14 February 2023|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=20 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230320011545/https://www.nme.com/features/gaming-features/hitman-freelancer-is-hitman-at-its-very-best-3398456|url-status=live}}</ref> When a leader is lured out, a "Showdown" mission becomes available, and 47's handler Diana informs the player of four physical and three behavioral characteristics of the leader.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-freelancer-tips-for-agent-47s-awesome-roguelite-mode/1100-6511183/|title=Hitman Freelancer: Tips For Agent 47's Awesome Roguelite can use their "suspect camera" to identify the syndicate leader in a level.<ref name="bolt"/> Each syndicate has a unique "syndicate type" which rewards a particular playstyle. Completing missions earns the player Merces, which can be used to purchase weapons and gear. In each map, players can earn extra Merces by eliminating Couriers and opening safes. They can find Suppliers who sell unique Freelancer weapons. Some weapons collected in a map may be brought back to the safehouse for use in future missions.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamer.com/hitman-freelancer-tips/|title=Seven tips to make murder in Hitman Freelancer|first=Sean|last=Martin|work=[[PC Gamer]]|date=1 February 2023|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=28 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230528032506/https://www.pcgamer.com/hitman-freelancer-tips/|url-status=live}}</ref> As Mastery Levels increase, 47's safehouse, which serves as a hub space for the mode, gradually expands.<ref name="GRadar Freelancer"/> If the player fails a mission, 47 loses all of the equipment that he brought with him and half of his Merces reserve. Future locations become more guarded, as the syndicate members become aware of 47's presence. If the player dies or fails a Showdown mission, the player's progress is reset.<ref name="bolt"/><ref>{{cite web|url=https://ftw.usatoday.com/2022/10/hitman-3-freelancer-mode-trailer|title=IO Interactive releases Hitman 3 Freelancer mode deep-dive|first=Josh|last=Broadwell|work=[[USA Today]]|date=27 October 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=30 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230330044234/https://ftw.usatoday.com/2022/10/hitman-3-freelancer-mode-trailer|url-status=live}}</ref>

A two-player [[cooperative multiplayer]] mode named "Stone & Knight" was announced in June 2025.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2025/06/assassinate-your-targets-with-pals-in-upcoming-hitman-co-op-mode|title=Assassinate Your Targets with Pals in Upcoming Hitman Co-Op Mode|first=Sammy|last=Barker|work=[[Push Square]]|date=7 June 2025|accessdate=7 June 2025}}</ref>

==Plot==
During the events of ''[[Hitman 2 (2018 video game)|Hitman 2]]'', [[Agent 47]] and his handler, Diana Burnwood, defect from the International Contract Agency (ICA) and join forces with rogue mercenary Lucas Grey to track down Providence, a secretive alliance of corporate executives, politicians, and industrialists collectively wielding political, military, and economic influence. In the game's final mission, the trio kidnap Arthur Edwards, Providence's intermediary known as the Constant, who identifies the three Partners controlling Providence: Carl Ingram, Marcus Stuyvesant, and Alexa Carlisle. Edwards, however, later escapes captivity and seized the Partners' corporate assets for himself. In ''Hitman 3'', 47 and Grey seek revenge on Providence for turning them both into assassins through childhood conditioning and genetic experimentation, while Diana is motivated by the death of her parents—unaware that 47 carried out the killings while under Providence's control.

Working together, 47 and Grey eliminate Ingram and Stuyvesant in [[Dubai]] during the inauguration of the Sceptre (modeled after the [[Burj Khalifa]]), the world's tallest skyscraper, and Carlisle at her ancestral manor in [[Dartmoor]]. Following the Partners' deaths, Edwards assumes control of Providence and deploys mercenaries to capture Grey. Disguised as a mercenary, 47 attempts to rescue Grey, but the latter commits suicide to prevent the former's cover from being blown.

47 arranges to meet hacker Olivia Hall, Grey's only other trusted ally, in [[Berlin]]. Discovering that the ICA is tailing them, 47 kills several ICA agents sent to eliminate him, before he and Hall decide to conclusively stop the ICA by exposing its crimes to the public. 47 eliminates Hush and Imogen Royce, the overseers of the ICA's data storage facility in [[Chongqing]], allowing Hall to steal and publish all of the ICA's operational data, while deleting all records referencing 47 and Diana. The ICA is irrevocably compromised and dismantled, ending 47's career as a professional assassin.

Meanwhile, Edwards attempts to convert Diana to succeed him as Constant and seeks her betrayal of 47 by revealing that he killed her parents. Diana seemingly double-deals both sides, accepting Edwards's offer while inviting 47 to a gathering of Providence members in [[Mendoza, Argentina|Mendoza]], where he is instructed to eliminate the only people opposed to Diana's succession—Tamara Vidal and Don Archibald Yates—so that she can dismantle the organization upon assuming control. After he follows her instructions, 47's longtime trust in Diana is shaken when she incapacitates him with poison, seemingly as revenge for the murder of her parents.

In a dream, a vision of Grey persuades 47 that Diana has not betrayed him, but rather helped to put Edwards within his reach. 47 wakes up imprisoned on a Providence-controlled train travelling in [[Romania]] through the [[Carpathian Mountains]]. 47 learns that Edwards is on board the train. When 47 confronts Edwards, he reveals that he had intended to once more turn 47 into a Providence assassin by wiping his memory through an injection of serum. Edwards leaves 47 with a choice: kill Edwards or inject himself with the serum, though 47 has the opportunity to inject Edwards with the serum instead. With Edwards either dead or amnesiac by the end of the mission, 47 flees into the wild. Meanwhile, Diana assumes power as Constant and enacts a purge of Providence's members from leadership positions at major global corporations, dismantling the alliance's power structure. A year later, 47 reconnects with Diana and the pair return to their former roles as assassin and handler, respectively, to keep the global elites in check, albeit now working freelance.

In an alternate ending, if 47 injects himself with the serum while confronting Edwards, he passes out and later awakens in a padded room, greeted by Edwards's voice saying: "Wake up. Wake up, my friend. It's the dawn of a new day, and you have things to do", echoing the opening of ''[[Hitman: Codename 47]]''.

==Development==
===Gameplay design===
The idea for each location in the game began with the team deciding on some keywords and phrases that would define the level's themes.<ref name=":7" /> Each area in the game was designed to be a lived-in space, big enough for players to explore and express their creativity. As with previous entries in the series, the team worked with contrasts. For instance, beneath the dark, rain-soaked streets of Chongqing lies a bright, hyper-modern research facility. Missions contrast each other. For instance, the Dubai level, which is set during the inauguration of the Scepter, the world's tallest skyscraper, is immediately followed by Dartmoor, which features a historic mansion.<ref name=":18"/>  Game director Mattias Engström said that, whereas the [[Mumbai]] and [[Miami]] missions in ''Hitman 2'' reached the limits of mission sizes, potentially overwhelming players, the team designed ''Hitman 3'' with the understanding that "it's better to be a little sharper and more focused, to create a more polished and coherent experience". The levels in ''Hitman 3'' are more experimental in nature, with the developer changing up the gameplay formula in certain missions (''e.g.'', the Berlin level), and implementing older ideas that they had not been able to implement (''e.g.,'' the murder-mystery in the Dartmoor level).<ref name=":18" />

Developers were inspired by [[immersive sim]] games in designing several features, such as keypads and other items that create puzzles for the player to solve. The introduction of persistent shortcuts that can only be opened from one direction, but will stay open permanently in all future playthroughs, was designed to "encourage exploration, reward curiosity, and incentivize replayability".<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Aken |first=Alex Van |date=5 January 2021 |title=Watch Our Exclusive Look At Hitman 3's Persistent Shortcuts |url=https://www.gameinformer.com/exclusive-video/2021/01/05/watch-our-exclusive-look-at-hitman-3s-persistent-shortcuts |url-status=live |magazine=[[Game Informer]] |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025435/https://www.gameinformer.com/exclusive-video/2021/01/05/watch-our-exclusive-look-at-hitman-3s-persistent-shortcuts |archive-date=11 January 2023 |access-date=4 June 2022}}</ref> Predictability and consistency were key factors for the AI, with developers wanting the game to be fun and interesting to experiment with even if it meant the AI seemed to be "stupid" sometimes.<ref name=":8" /> Scripting for the game's [[artificial intelligence]], however, required immense effort from the team. The team had frequent meetings to discuss changing target's behaviour, and spent a significant amount of time ensuring that the system and the simulation would not break, even if the player performs unconventional actions.<ref name=":18"/>

===Level design===
[[File:Vineyard in Mendoza, Argentina.jpg|thumb|One of the missions in the game takes place in a vineyard in [[Mendoza, Argentina]].]]
For the opening mission in [[Dubai]], Engström gave the level designers and artists several phrases, such as "an inviting beginning", "open and airy", and "on top of the world" (which is the name for the mission in the game).<ref name=":7">{{Cite magazine |last=Cork |first=Jeff |date=22 January 2021 |title=Hitman 3's Developers Share What Makes Its Berlin Level Special |url=https://www.gameinformer.com/2021/01/22/hitman-3s-developers-share-what-makes-its-berlin-level-special |url-status=live |magazine=[[Game Informer]] |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220506040945/https://www.gameinformer.com/2021/01/22/hitman-3s-developers-share-what-makes-its-berlin-level-special |archive-date=6 May 2022 |access-date=4 June 2022}}</ref> During development the team felt that the level was not living up to the "vertigo" and "verticality" keywords, and that the level would not give the player the feeling that they were high up on a massive skyscraper. As a result, the beginning of the mission was changed so that the player started outside of the skyscraper and working their way in, rather than starting by exiting an elevator into an atrium.<ref name=":8">{{Cite web |last= |date=23 December 2020 |title=Deep Dive into HITMAN 3 - Game Informer |url=https://www.hitmanforum.com/t/deep-dive-into-hitman-3-game-informer/59 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201224211546/https://www.hitmanforum.com/t/deep-dive-into-hitman-3-game-informer/59 |archive-date=24 December 2020 |access-date=4 June 2022 |website=Hitman Forum |language=en}}</ref> IO Interactive's art director and lead environment artist visited Dubai early in development to gather reference material.<ref name=":18">{{Cite news |last=Kelly |first=Andy |date=27 January 2021 |title=How IO made the Hitman trilogy, its stealth masterpiece |language=en |work=[[PC Gamer]] |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/how-io-made-the-hitman-trilogy-its-stealth-masterpiece/ |url-status=live |access-date=21 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210307130401/https://www.pcgamer.com/how-io-made-the-hitman-trilogy-its-stealth-masterpiece/ |archive-date=7 March 2021}}</ref>

[[Dartmoor]] was based around phrases like "a house filled with secrets", "ominous", and "vulnerable".<ref name=":7" /> The mansion setting was decided quite early on in development and features a gothic design inspired by [[detective fiction]], such as [[Agatha Christie]] novels.<ref name=":16">{{Cite news |last=Favis |first=Elise |date=12 February 2021 |title=The making of the 'Hitman 3' murder mystery mansion |newspaper=[[The Washington Post]] |url=https://www.washingtonpost.com/video-games/2021/02/12/hitman-murder-mystery-dartmoor/ |url-status=live |access-date=20 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210620050753/https://www.washingtonpost.com/video-games/2021/02/12/hitman-murder-mystery-dartmoor/ |archive-date=20 June 2021}}</ref> The linear structure of a murder-mystery caused IO to rework some of the mechanics and narrative paths, as they clashed with the design principles of replayibility and player freedom. The team experimented with using randomized culprits, but struggled to build a narrative. Despite the singular, fixed story, players are required to replay the level several times to get the full picture of the incident.<ref name=":8" /> The player can gather evidence to accuse different characters, resulting in different outcomes. The story requires a detective disguise to allow free access to most of the level, in contrast to most ''Hitman'' levels, where the player has to avoid being detected.<ref name=":8" /> The first version of the mission allowed the player full freedom to explore rooms and talk to people, but the player would not know who exactly they could talk to or which rooms were relevant. The team highlighted all of the people and objects of interest, resulting in a dull experience for playtesters, who would merely follow each icon and interact with all prompts. The final version of the mission uses more subtle ways to guide players, such as through conversations between staff members and guards. Sound cues, such as a draft of wind through a room or the sound of ruffling paper, were used to hint the player in the right direction towards clues. The addition of a secondary target, where the player would be asked to eliminate the true culprit, was considered but ultimately cut.<ref name=":16" /><ref name=":17">{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jwz5qnzDfkQ |title=The making of the 'Hitman 3' murder mystery mansion (IO Interactive interview) {{!}} Launcher |date=13 February 2021 |language=en |newspaper=[[The Washington Post|Washington Post Gaming]] |access-date=20 July 2022 |via=[[YouTube]]}}</ref>

The [[Berlin]] mission was based on the key words "loneliness" and "isolation".<ref name=":7" /> The forest featured in the opening was deliberately designed to be cold and isolating to contrast with the rave found in the main part of the level.<ref name=":18" /> IO sought to make the rave and music in the Berlin nightclub authentic.<ref name=":7" /> The main level designer for the mission lives in Berlin and did location scouting for the level, taking reference photos and recording sounds.<ref name=":18" /> Instead of using tracks from other sources, ''Hitman 3'' composer Niels Bye Nielsen wrote the music that is played at the rave. The crowd NPCs are programmed to adjust their dance moves in response to the music as it builds.<ref name=":7" /> Berlin features none of the guided mission stories found in other ''Hitman'' levels, and the player must identify the targets by themselves. While the team initially included a primary target, Agent Montgomery, and the other agents as optional targets, it later decided to leave the choice of targets up to the player. Initially, all 10 agents would show up in the game's instinct mode, but the team found that to be overwhelming for a first playthrough.<ref name=":19">{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfJ-vGXX9ag |title=Making Hitman 3's Best Level |date=12 May 2022 |language=en |publisher=[[Game Maker's Toolkit]] |access-date=3 June 2022 |via=[[YouTube]] |archive-date=3 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220603101655/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lfJ-vGXX9ag |url-status=live }}</ref> Berlin is the first level in the trilogy to feature armed targets who will fight back instead of running into lockdown. Earlier versions of the level included agents patrolling as pairs and targets immediately pulling out their weapon to shoot Agent 47 upon spotting him; the team deemed that design too punishing. Berlin was the most expensive level to make as a result of the development of features, such as target identification and different methods of presenting information to the player.<ref name=":18" />

The [[Mendoza, Argentina|Mendoza]] location was IO Interactive's first attempt to depict [[Argentina]] in the ''Hitman'' franchise. The original two ideas for the level were a "tango location set in [[Buenos Aires]]" or a vineyard in [[South Africa]]. Both ideas were combined and Mendoza was chosen because it is an internationally known [[Mendoza wine|wine]] producing region. The company went to great lengths to create a fictional location with authentic-looking terrain and vegetation, to show the [[winemaking]] process, and to accurately portray aspects of Argentine culture, such as [[tango]] and the drinking of [[Mate (drink)|mate]]. As IO Interactive's associate producer Pablo Prada is from Argentina, he provided insight for many aspects of the level. The real-life {{Ill|Villavicencio Natural Reserve|es|Reserva Natural Villavicencio}} was an inspiration for the architecture of the level. Professional dancers were hired for the tango animations and consulted about the music. The designers reused existing NPC Spanish-dialect dialogue, which had been recorded with [[Colombian Spanish|Colombian]] and [[Mexican Spanish|Mexican]] accents, rather than recording new NPC dialogue with [[Rioplatense Spanish|Argentine accents]], due to time and budgetary constraints, as well as the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. The company instead chose to focus on securing appropriate voice talent for the Chongqing location.<ref name="Arguello">{{cite news |last1=Arguello |first1=Diego |date=2 February 2021 |title=Hitman 3's Argentina Mission Marks an Important First for Video Games |work=[[Inverse (website)|Inverse]] |publisher=[[Bustle Digital Group]] |url=https://www.inverse.com/gaming/hitman-3-mendoza-argentina |url-status=live |access-date=3 February 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210202140527/https://www.inverse.com/gaming/hitman-3-mendoza-argentina |archive-date=2 February 2021}}</ref>

Ambrose Island was added as a free [[downloadable content]] (DLC) update in 2022. The level is set during the events of ''Hitman 2''. Live game director Kevin Goyon said that the team wanted to create a "pirate fantasy" and "to make a location that felt dangerous – but where 47 would belong". IO wanted to explore what happened to Lucas Grey's militia after he left it during ''Hitman 2''. The team explored the idea of rival factions, with the militia and pirates on the island on the brink of a conflict. Goyon said that this allowed them "to create a rich lore and interesting situations".<ref name=":6" /> The island location provided a natural way to define the boundaries of the map. In contrast to other outdoor ''Hitman'' maps, which revolve around built-up areas (''e.g.'', ''Hitman 2''{{'}}s Santa Fortuna and Mumbai), Ambrose Island was designed around the natural rocky topology and jungles of the island, with much of the map consisting of natural environments. The topology and jungles divide the map into different zones, allowing the team to experiment with more verticality than usual on the map.<ref name=":6">{{Cite web |last=Broadwell |first=Josh |date=29 July 2022 |title=How the new Hitman 3 map became a tropical pirate playground |url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/hitman-3/map-pirate-playground |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230107142722/https://www.pcgamesn.com/hitman-3/map-pirate-playground |archive-date=7 January 2023 |access-date=18 August 2022 |website=PCGamesN |language=en-GB}}</ref>

===Story===
In ''Hitman 3'', the developers emphasized the game's story aspects and sought to create closure for 47's character.<ref name="poly story">{{cite web|url=https://www.polygon.com/features/22348375/hitman-3-story-levels-carpathian-mountains-io-interactive-47|title=In Hitman 3, Agent 47's freedom is more important than yours|first=Samit|last=Sarker|work=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]]|date=26 March 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=4 June 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220604175536/https://www.polygon.com/features/22348375/hitman-3-story-levels-carpathian-mountains-io-interactive-47|url-status=live}}</ref> The game incorporates hand-crafted moments designed around the first time playthrough, with the aim being to integrate many core story moments into the gameplay.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Donaldson |first=Alex |date=8 January 2021 |title=Hitman 3 is a confident, iterative trilogy finale that looks as brilliant as its predecessors |url=https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-hands-on-preview |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025433/https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-hands-on-preview |archive-date=11 January 2023 |access-date=5 June 2022 |website=[[VG247]] |language=en}}</ref> ''Hitman 2'' established the major players, and ''Hitman 3'' allows each of these characters to develop their own [[character arc]] and become more involved in both the story and the gameplay. Throughout all three games, [[Agent 47]] is undergoing a period of [[self-discovery]]: learning about his past, rebuilding his relationships with other characters, and realizing his ability to exercise his [[free will]]. The Berlin level, in which 47 refuses one of his allies' advice to leave the compound and instead opts to eliminate the ICA agents sent to hunt him, was considered to be an important "character moment" for him, as it represents the first instance in which he must make a choice. The Mendoza level is the first time the player meets Diana face-to-face in the trilogy. At the end of the mission, 47 dances with Diana for a tango. IO chose to limit the player's outfit choices for this particular moment in order to maintain the atmosphere and not undermine the storytelling.<ref name="poly story"/> The Carpathian Mountains level, which was controversial for its linear design, was described by Engström as a "narratively driven set-piece that is setting up closure for the trilogy". The train was designed as a metaphor for 47 spending his life "following a path determined by others", with his stepping off the train at the end being symbolic of 47 leaving his past as a contract killer behind at the end of the story.<ref name="poly story"/> The game had a "more mature, serious, darker" tone when compared with ''Hitman 2'', which features a more lighthearted tone.<ref name="more serious">{{cite web|url=https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-will-mature-serious-darker-tone|title=Hitman 3 will be "more mature, serious, darker" and probably won't let you slap a man with a fish|first=Kirk|last=McKeand|work=[[VG 247]]|date=25 June 2021|access-date=21 September 2021|archive-date=21 September 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210921111740/https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-will-mature-serious-darker-tone|url-status=live}}</ref> The team took a more measured approach to the game's humor. While elements of lightheartedness are still core to the game's design, they are more likely to be discovered in subsequent playthroughs and are not as "front and center" as in ''Hitman 2''.<ref name="writer">{{cite web|url=https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-interview|title=Hitman Interview: IO Interactive on lessons learned, the future, and closing out the World of Assassination with a bang|first=Alex|last=Donaldson|work=[[VG 247]]|date=8 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065537/https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-interview|url-status=live}}</ref>

The game had six writers and a producer who managed the writing team. According to Forest Swartout Large, the game's executive producer, the dialogue budget accounted for a significant proportion of the overall development budget because the team had to write dialogue for not only the linear story, but also the [[emergent gameplay]].<ref name="writer"/> The game's voice cast includes [[David Bateson]] as Agent 47, [[Jane Perry (actress)|Jane Perry]] as Diana Burnwood, [[John Hopkins (actor)|John Hopkins]] as Lucas Grey, Isaura Barbé-Brown as Olivia Hall, and Phillip Rosch as Arthur Edwards.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.shacknews.com/article/118914/hitman-3-voice-actors-and-cast|title=Hitman 3 voice actors and cast|first=Josh|last=Hawkins|work=[[Shacknews]]|date=26 June 2020|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=7 August 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220807233730/https://www.shacknews.com/article/118914/hitman-3-voice-actors-and-cast|url-status=live}}</ref> For the incidental dialogue, Bateson was instructed not to diversify his accent to fit the context of the situation. Instead, he was directed to deliver dialogue in a "delightfully wooden" way and deliver each line, regardless of how absurd it may be, seriously.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamer.com/david-bateson-on-20-years-of-playing-hitmans-agent-47-hes-my-best-friend/|title=David Bateson on 20 years of playing Hitman's Agent 47: 'He's my best friend!'|first=Andy|last=Kelly|work=[[PC Gamer]]|date=26 February 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=2 March 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210302200929/https://www.pcgamer.com/david-bateson-on-20-years-of-playing-hitmans-agent-47-hes-my-best-friend/|url-status=live}}</ref> Bateson further stated that he wanted to "give [47] almost a kind of Frankenstein's monster feel to him".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eurogamer.net/hitmans-voice-cast-on-playing-outsiders-absurd-humour-and-ios-future-with-bond|title=Hitman's voice cast on playing outsiders, absurd humour, and IO's future with Bond|first=Ed|last=Nightingale|work=[[Eurogamer]]|date=5 May 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065538/https://www.eurogamer.net/hitmans-voice-cast-on-playing-outsiders-absurd-humour-and-ios-future-with-bond|url-status=live}}</ref> Reflecting on the evolution of dark humour across the three games, Bateson said that "[it] has matured and evolved like a good cheese or a good wine, without the writers wanting to belittle or turn it into some kind of a lightweight comedy, because it's not. People are dying horrific deaths. But it's nice to have that dark humour".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/gaming-news/hitman-voice-actors-reveal-their-favourite-kills-in-the-series-3220626|title='Hitman' voice actors reveal their favourite kills in the series|first=Daniel|last=Conlan|work=[[NME]]|date=6 May 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=29 January 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230129092529/https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/gaming-news/hitman-voice-actors-reveal-their-favourite-kills-in-the-series-3220626|url-status=live}}</ref>

=== Technology ===
IO Interactive reduced the file size of ''Hitman 3''—including the data for the first two games in the trilogy—to 60-70 [[Gigabyte|GB]], as compared to ''Hitman 2''{{'s}} 150 GB size. Engine improvements, [[data deduplication]] and lossless [[LZ4 (compression algorithm)|LZ4 compression]] were the main contributors to the file size reduction.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Fenlon |first=Wes |date=11 January 2021 |title=How Hitman 3's devs shrank the entire trilogy install size by over 80GB |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/uk/how-hitman-3s-devs-shrank-the-entire-trilogys-install-size-by-over-80gb/ |url-status=live |work=[[PC Gamer]] |language=en-US |access-date=16 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210608145500/https://www.pcgamer.com/uk/how-hitman-3s-devs-shrank-the-entire-trilogys-install-size-by-over-80gb/ |archive-date=8 June 2021}}</ref> In November 2020, IO Interactive announced that they had teamed up with [[Intel]] to optimise ''Hitman 3'' performance on high-end CPUs with 8+ cores, which allowed the team to include more crowds and [[destructible environment]]s. They used Variable Rate Shading, a technique for improving rendering performance by dynamically changing the rate of shading in different parts of the frame.<ref>{{Cite web |date=23 November 2020 |title=IOI x Intel |url=https://www.ioi.dk/ioi-intel-hitman3/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230107141822/https://www.ioi.dk/ioi-intel-hitman3/ |archive-date=7 January 2023 |website=[[IO Interactive]] |language=en-US |access-date=18 April 2022}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Humphries |first=Matthew |date=24 November 2020 |title=Hitman 3 Is Being Enhanced for Intel CPUs With 8+ Cores |url=https://uk.pcmag.com/pc-games/130161/hitman-3-is-being-enhanced-for-intel-cpus-with-8-cores |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025433/https://uk.pcmag.com/pc-games/130161/hitman-3-is-being-enhanced-for-intel-cpus-with-8-cores |archive-date=11 January 2023 |website=[[PCMag UK]] |language=en-GB |access-date=18 April 2022}}</ref> Additional graphics features were added to the game on 24 May 2022, enabling [[Ray tracing (graphics)|ray traced]] [[Reflection (computer graphics)|reflections]] and ray traced shadows from the sun while indoor shadows still use traditional [[Shadow mapping|shadow maps]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Battaglia |first1=Alex |date=29 May 2022 |title=Hitman 3's PC ray tracing upgrade is beautiful - but comes with a big cost |url=https://www.digitalfoundry.net/articles/digitalfoundry-2022-hitman-3s-pc-ray-tracing-upgrade-is-beautiful-but-comes-with-a-big-cost |website=Digital Foundry |language=en-GB |access-date=2 February 2026}}</ref> Support for [[supersampling]] techniques such as Nvidia's [[DLSS]] and [[AMD]]'s [[FidelityFX Super Resolution]] was also added.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Archer |first=James |date=25 May 2022 |title=Hitman 3 ray tracing arrives, kills performance, escapes in nice suit |url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/hitman-3-ray-tracing-performance |url-status=live |work=[[Rock Paper Shotgun]] |language=en-GB |access-date=2 June 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220602090007/https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/hitman-3-ray-tracing-performance |archive-date=2 June 2022}}</ref>
[[File:Glacier Engine NPC Interactions in HITMAN VR (InSWSdUYeHw) IO Interactive (UC3weMspMB9NQ8rn G75yeSg) 2022-09-27 (1664274074).webm|thumb|Development video of NPC interactions in ''Hitman VR'']]

The idea to add a [[virtual reality]] (VR) mode originated in 2018, when a senior game designer brought his [[PlayStation VR]] headset into the office to show it off. People at the office "couldn't stop playing" the game ''[[Firewall: Zero Hour]]'', which inspired the developers to make their own VR mode for ''Hitman 3''. The VR team, which was made up of 10 to 12 people, believed that the game's level design suited the new perspective offered by VR, even though they were not designed with it in mind. The [[cover system]] was reworked, with players physically crouching to hide out of sight instead of locking into a cover system. They enabled players to have free-form movement with the game's melee weapons, instead of using scripted animations.<ref name=":8" /> Many items, which previously would have been quite small on the screen or obscured by UI, were redesigned to include more detail. The team used the [[holographic sight]]s for aiming in first-person. Despite VR being designed to be an immersive personal experience, the team decided not to tone down any of the violent content of the game.<ref>{{Cite magazine |last=Hester |first=Blake |date=29 December 2020 |title=Bringing Hitman To VR |url=https://www.gameinformer.com/2020/12/29/bringing-hitman-to-vr |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025435/https://www.gameinformer.com/2020/12/29/bringing-hitman-to-vr |archive-date=11 January 2023 |magazine=[[Game Informer]] |language=en |access-date=3 June 2022}}</ref> IO Interactive and XR Games announced ''Hitman 3 VR: Reloaded'' in June 2024, releasing  it exclusively for [[Meta Quest 3]] in September.<ref>{{cite web |last=Bonthyus |first=Darryn |date=4 June 2024 |title=Hitman 3 Is Reloading For Another Run At VR Assassinations |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-is-reloading-for-another-run-at-vr-assassinations/1100-6523855/ |work=[[GameSpot]] |language=en-US |accessdate=21 August 2024 |archive-date=25 August 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240825103808/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-is-reloading-for-another-run-at-vr-assassinations/1100-6523855/|url-status=live}}</ref>

==Release==
The game was announced on 11 June 2020 at the [[PlayStation 5]] reveal event with the [[tagline]] 'Death Awaits'.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Grubb |first=Jeff |date=11 June 2020 |title=Hitman 3 concludes Agent 47's story when it launches January 2021 |url=https://venturebeat.com/2020/06/11/hitman-3-concludes-agent-47s-story-when-it-launches-january-2021/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220115132118/https://venturebeat.com/2020/06/11/hitman-3-concludes-agent-47s-story-when-it-launches-january-2021/ |archive-date=15 January 2022 |access-date=11 June 2020 |website=[[VentureBeat]] |language=en-US}}</ref> Development concluded after a year and a half with a total budget of $20 million.<ref>{{cite podcast| url= https://gamemakersnotebook.libsyn.com/exploring-the-world-of-hitman-with-io-interactives-hakan-abrak| title= Exploring the World of Hitman with IO Interactive's Hakan Abrak| website= Interactive.org| publisher= Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences Foundation| host= Orth, Adam| date= 19 December 2024| time= 51:11| access-date=26 February 2025}}</ref> IO Interactive [[self-published]] the game.<ref name="self-publishing"/> ''Hitman 3'' was released for [[Windows]], [[PlayStation 4]], [[PlayStation 5]], [[Xbox One]], and [[Xbox Series X and Series S]] natively, [[Nintendo Switch]] via [[Cloud gaming|cloud streaming technology]], and cloud gaming service [[Google Stadia|Stadia]] (under the title ''Hitman: World of Assassination'').<ref>{{cite magazine |last=Chalk |first=Andy |date=14 July 2020 |title='Stadia is getting Hitman, Sekiro, Outriders, and some new exclusives |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/stadia-is-getting-hitman-sekiro-outriders-and-some-new-exclusives/ |url-status=live |magazine=[[PC Gamer]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230113135416/https://www.pcgamer.com/stadia-is-getting-hitman-sekiro-outriders-and-some-new-exclusives/ |archive-date=13 January 2023 |access-date=16 July 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/gaming-news/hitman-3-has-been-confirmed-to-arrive-on-the-nintendo-switch-next-week-2858497|title='Hitman 3' has been confirmed to arrive on the Nintendo Switch next week|first=Daniel|last=Hollis|work=[[NME]]|date=15 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=22 September 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210922092950/https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/gaming-news/hitman-3-has-been-confirmed-to-arrive-on-the-nintendo-switch-next-week-2858497|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/ps5-hitman-3-release-date-january-2021|title=Hitman 3 Coming to PS5 in January 2021|first=Joe|last=Skrebels|work=[[IGN]]|date=12 June 2020|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=26 October 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221026235328/https://www.ign.com/articles/ps5-hitman-3-release-date-january-2021|url-status=live}}</ref> A VR mode was released for [[PlayStation VR]] on the same day. Full VR and motion control support for PC players became available in January 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/gaming-news/hitman-3-year-2-out-now-adds-elusive-target-arcade-and-pc-vr-support-3142908|title='Hitman 3' Year 2 out now – adds Elusive Target Arcade and PC VR support|first=Jack|last=Grimshaw|work=[[NME]]|date=20 January 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=29 January 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230129034231/https://www.nme.com/en_asia/news/gaming-news/hitman-3-year-2-out-now-adds-elusive-target-arcade-and-pc-vr-support-3142908|url-status=live}}</ref> Players who pre-ordered the game received the "Trinity Pack", which includes a collection of items inspired by the two previous games in the ''World of Assassination'' trilogy. A commemorative passport celebrating the 20th anniversary of the franchise is available for players who preordered the physical version of ''Hitman 3 Deluxe Edition'', which was released with [[Limited Run Games]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-release-week-buying-guide-preorder-bonuses-discounts-editions-and-more/1100-6481519/|title=Hitman 3 Release Week Buying Guide: Preorder Bonuses, Discounts, Editions, And More|first=Mat|last=Paget|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=19 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=2 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230602190841/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-release-week-buying-guide-preorder-bonuses-discounts-editions-and-more/1100-6481519/|url-status=live}}</ref> IO Interactive had considered returning to the [[Episodic video game|episodic]] model for ''Hitman 3'' like that seen in 2016's ''Hitman'', wherein the first location would have been released in August 2020.<ref name="self-publishing">{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GaHSE63F0Y4 |title=Self-publishing Hitman: How IO took control of its destiny |date=16 April 2021 |last=Dring |first=Chris |language=en |publisher=[[GamesIndustry.biz]] |access-date=22 July 2022 |via=[[YouTube]] |archive-date=22 July 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220722162127/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GaHSE63F0Y4 |url-status=live }}</ref> The ''Hitman 3 Free Starter Pack'' was made available on 30 March 2021, which grants players permanent access to the ICA Facility training missions from 2016's ''Hitman'' and periodic free access to other locations from the trilogy.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3s-new-starter-pack-lets-you-play-bits-of-the-series-for-free|title=Hitman 3's new Starter Pack lets you play bits of the series for free|first=Matt|last=Wales|work=[[Eurogamer]]|date=30 March 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065554/https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3s-new-starter-pack-lets-you-play-bits-of-the-series-for-free|url-status=live}}</ref> In September 2022, [[Google]] announced that Stadia would be shut down in January 2023. In response, IO Interactive announced that Stadia players would be able to transfer their progress to other platforms from 11 January to 17 February 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.theverge.com/2022/12/15/23511313/hitman-stadia-progression-carryover-platforms-shutdown|title=Hitman players about to be abandoned by Stadia will be able to transfer their progress|first=Jay|last=Peters|work=[[The Verge]]|date=16 December 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=20 January 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230120234254/https://www.theverge.com/2022/12/15/23511313/hitman-stadia-progression-carryover-platforms-shutdown|url-status=live}}</ref>

IO Interactive signed a 12-month exclusivity period for the Windows version with the [[Epic Games Store]], explaining "as an independent studio, our partnership with [[Epic Games|Epic]] has given us the freedom to create ''Hitman 3'' exactly as we imagined and self-publish the game to our players directly".<ref>{{Cite web |author1=Vikki Blake |date=22 August 2020 |title=Hitman 3 on PC will have a 12-month exclusivity period with Epic Games Store |url=https://www.gamesradar.com/uk/hitman-3-on-pc-will-have-a-12-month-exclusivity-period-with-epic-games-store/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220418050607/https://www.gamesradar.com/uk/hitman-3-on-pc-will-have-a-12-month-exclusivity-period-with-epic-games-store/ |archive-date=18 April 2022 |access-date=18 April 2022 |website=[[GamesRadar+]] |language=en}}</ref> Prior to the game's launch, IO Interactive announced that unlike console players, PC players who owned ''Hitman'' or ''Hitman 2'' on [[Steam (software)|Steam]] would not be able to unlock locations from previous games in ''Hitman 3'' unless they repurchased them on the Epic Games Store, backtracking on their promise.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamesindustry.biz/io-interactive-assures-hitman-3-players-will-not-have-to-repurchase-previous-entries|title=IO Interactive assures Hitman 3 players will not have to repurchase previous entries|first=Marie|last=Dealessandri|work=[[Gameindustry.biz]]|date=18 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=6 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230206090938/https://www.gamesindustry.biz/io-interactive-assures-hitman-3-players-will-not-have-to-repurchase-previous-entries|url-status=live}}</ref> This led to criticism over IO's exclusivity deal with the Epic Games Store. [[Tim Sweeney]], Epic Games' CEO, issued an apology and committed to working with IO Interactive on a solution to allow Steam players to import locations to the Epic Games Store. IO guaranteed that players would not need to repurchase the games, however they admitted that there would be a delay and players would not be able to import ''Hitman 2'' locations into ''Hitman 3'' for another few weeks.<ref>{{Citation |last=Bankhurst |first=Adam |title=Hitman 3: PC Players Will Be Able to Play Hitman 1 and 2 Levels For Free If They Own Them |date=17 January 2021 |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-pc-players-will-be-able-to-play-hitman-1-and-2-levels-for-free-if-they-own-them |access-date=18 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025437/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-pc-players-will-be-able-to-play-hitman-1-and-2-levels-for-free-if-they-own-them |url-status=live |publisher=[[IGN]] |language=en |archive-date=11 January 2023}}</ref> IO offered 2016's ''Hitman: Game of the Year Edition'' to players who pre-ordered or purchased the game within its first ten days of release on PC.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-pc-players-will-be-able-to-play-hitman-1-and-2-levels-for-free-if-they-own-them|title=Hitman 3: PC Players Will Be Able to Play Hitman 1 and 2 Levels For Free If They Own Them|first=Adam|last=Bankhurst|work=[[IGN]]|date=18 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=18 January 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210118062811/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-pc-players-will-be-able-to-play-hitman-1-and-2-levels-for-free-if-they-own-them|url-status=live}}</ref> The location transfer system was implemented a month later.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-level-transfer-for-pc-could-arrive-end-of-february|title=Hitman 3 Level Transfer for PC Could Arrive 'End of February'|first=Joseph|last=Knoop|work=[[IGN]]|date=6 February 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=5 February 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230205215015/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-level-transfer-for-pc-could-arrive-end-of-february|url-status=live}}</ref>

On 13 January 2022, IO Interactive announced the ''Hitman Trilogy'', a collection of all three games in the ''World of Assassination'' trilogy. Both ''Hitman 3'' and the ''Hitman Trilogy'' were released for [[Steam (service)|Steam]] on 20 January 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pcgamesn.com/hitman-3/steam-release-time|title=Hitman 3 Steam release time – here's when Agent 47 arrives|first=Carrie|last=Talbot|work=[[PCGamesN]]|date=20 January 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230401111911/https://www.pcgamesn.com/hitman-3/steam-release-time|url-status=live}}</ref> Upon launch, the Steam version was met with a wave of negative reviews from players who complained about the price being the same as when the game had launched on the Epic Games Store a year earlier.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Moore |first=Jared |date=27 January 2022 |title=Hitman 3: Steam Owners Will Get Free Upgrades to Make Up for Shaky Launch |url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-steam-owners-get-free-upgrades-shaky-launch |access-date=17 April 2022 |website=[[IGN]] |language=en |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417173506/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-steam-owners-get-free-upgrades-shaky-launch |url-status=live }}</ref> The pricing system was seen as confusing by some due to the large amount of different versions of the game available.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Smith |first=Graham |date=22 January 2022 |title=Hitman 3 has 50% negative reviews on Steam |language=en |work=[[Rock Paper Shotgun]] |url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/hitman-3-has-50-negative-reviews-on-steam |access-date=17 April 2022 |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417173506/https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/hitman-3-has-50-negative-reviews-on-steam |url-status=live }}</ref> In response, IO Interactive issued a statement saying that the "''Hitman 3'' launch on Steam didn't go as planned" and offered all players who had already bought the game or who purchased it through to 19 February a free upgrade to the Deluxe Edition of the game. Players who already owned or purchased either the Deluxe Edition or the ''Hitman Trilogy'' would receive the Seven Deadly Sins DLC for free instead.<ref>{{Cite web |last=McWhertor |first=Michael |date=27 January 2022 |title=Hitman dev offers free Hitman 3 upgrades on Steam to furious players |url=https://www.polygon.com/22904489/hitman-3-steam-launch-free-upgrade |access-date=17 April 2022 |website=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]] |language=en-US |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417173506/https://www.polygon.com/22904489/hitman-3-steam-launch-free-upgrade |url-status=live }}</ref>

IO Interactive supported ''Hitman 3'' extensively with post-launch updates.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-winter-roadmap-december-january|title=Hitman 3 Winter Roadmap outlines what to expect through January|first=Stephanny|last=Nunneley-Jackson|date=2 December 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=22 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230522125840/https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-winter-roadmap-december-january|url-status=live}}</ref> IO Interactive launched a seven-part [[downloadable content]] series named ''Seven Deadly Sins''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-dlc-series-pits-agent-47-against-the-seven-deadly-sins/1100-6489248/|title=Hitman 3 DLC Series Pits Agent 47 Against The Seven Deadly Sins|first=Darryn|last=Bonthyus|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=14 March 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=27 January 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220127144715/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-dlc-series-pits-agent-47-against-the-seven-deadly-sins/1100-6489248/|url-status=live}}</ref> The sins are Greed, Pride, Sloth, Lust, Gluttony, Envy and Wrath, with the packs being released in that order. The first pack (''Greed'') was released on 30 March. The packs can be bought individually or collectively as part of a [[Season pass (video games)|season pass]]. Each pack contains a unique escalation, a new suit and a new sin-themed item.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-seven-deadly-sins-expansion-announced|title=Hitman 3: Seven Deadly Sins Expansion Announced|first=Matt|last=Purslow|work=[[IGN]]|date=24 March 2021|access-date=25 March 2021|archive-date=25 March 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210325011319/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-seven-deadly-sins-expansion-announced|url-status=live}}</ref> The release of each pack started a new 'Season of Sin' lasting between four and six weeks, during which the regular free content such as featured contracts and elusive targets would be themed around the sin for that season. The final pack (Wrath) was released on 26 October 2021, with the "Season of Wrath" concluding on 29 November.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Nunneley-Jackson |first=Stephany |date=26 October 2021 |title=Hitman 3 Season of Wrath is the final Seven Deadly Sins Act and it's live |url=https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-season-of-wrath-is-live |access-date=17 April 2022 |website=[[VG247]] |language=en |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417021114/https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-season-of-wrath-is-live |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last1=Barbour |first1=Travis |date=26 October 2021 |title=Season of Wrath |url=https://www.ioi.dk/season-of-wrath/ |access-date=17 April 2022 |website=IO Interactive |language=en-US |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417021114/https://www.ioi.dk/season-of-wrath/ |url-status=live }}</ref> While IO initially declared that they were unlikely to make new maps for the locations and instead, focused on "reimagining" existing locations,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3s-dlc-may-be-a-reimagining-of-existing-locations|title=Hitman 3's DLC May Be a 'Reimagining' of Existing Locations|first=Adam|last=Bankhurst|work=[[IGN]]|date=31 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=27 January 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230127022032/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3s-dlc-may-be-a-reimagining-of-existing-locations|url-status=live}}</ref> they released "Ambrose Island", a new location for free in July 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/19-months-after-launch-hitman-3-adds-a-brand-new-map-for-free-later-this-month/1100-6505236/|title=19 Months After Launch, Hitman 3 Adds A Brand-New Map For Free Later This Month|first=Darryn|last=Bonthuys|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=8 July 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=7 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230707101157/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/19-months-after-launch-hitman-3-adds-a-brand-new-map-for-free-later-this-month/1100-6505236/|url-status=live}}</ref> The Freelancer mode was originally set to be released in 2022, though its release was pushed to January 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-freelancer-mode-delay-2023-roadmap-revealed|title=Hitman 3's Freelancer Mode Pushed to 2023, Roadmap Revealed|first=Ryan|last=Dinsdale|work=[[IGN]]|date=6 October 2022|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=31 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230331233228/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-freelancer-mode-delay-2023-roadmap-revealed|url-status=live}}</ref> Alongside Freelancer's release, IO Interactive announced that ''Hitman 3'' would be rebranded as ''Hitman: World of Assassination'', packaging both ''Hitman Game of the Year Edition'' and ''Hitman 2 Standard Access Pass'' into ''Hitman 3''. The two older ''Hitman'' games were then removed from storefronts. The Deluxe version of the game includes ''Hitman 2 Expansion Access Pass'', which allows players to gain access to the New York Bank DLC level and the Haven Island level, ''Hitman 3 Deluxe Edition'' and the ''Seven Deadly Sins'' DLC packs.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-being-rebranded-as-world-of-assassination-putting-entire-trilogy-in-one-package|title=Hitman 3 Being Rebranded as World of Assassination, Putting Entire Trilogy in One Package|first=Ryan|last=Dinsdale|work=[[IGN]]|date=5 January 2023|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=31 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230731175429/https://www.ign.com/articles/hitman-3-being-rebranded-as-world-of-assassination-putting-entire-trilogy-in-one-package|url-status=live}}</ref> ''Hitman: World of Assassination'' was released for [[PlayStation VR2]] on 27 March 2025,<ref>{{cite web |url=https://blog.playstation.com/2025/03/17/hitman-world-of-assassination-ps-vr2-qa/ |website=[[PlayStation]] |title=Hitman World of Assassination PS VR2 interview |first=Corey |last=Brotherson |date=2025-03-17 |access-date=2026-06-04}}</ref> and for the [[Nintendo Switch 2]] on 5 June as a launch title for that console.<ref>{{cite web |last=Makuch |first=Eddie |date=2 April 2025 |title=New James Bond Game And Hitman Coming To Switch 2 |url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/new-james-bond-game-and-hitman-coming-to-switch-2/1100-6530553/ |accessdate=2 April 2025 |work=[[GameSpot]]}}</ref> Ports for [[iOS]] and [[iPadOS]] were released on 27 August, followed by a [[macOS]] port on 25 February 2026.<ref>{{Cite web |title=HITMAN World of Assassination Gets macOS Support and New Elusive Target - Blue's News Story |url=https://www.bluesnews.com/s/294948/hitman-world-of-assassination-gets-macos-support-and-new-elusive-target |access-date=26 February 2026 |website=www.bluesnews.com}}</ref>
