''Hitman 3'' received "generally favorable" reviews, according to [[review aggregator]] platform [[Metacritic]].<ref name="MCPC"/><ref name="MCPS4"/><ref name="MCPS5"/><ref name="MCXSXS"/><ref name=MCPSVR2/> It has been considered by some critics to be the best entry in the series and one of the greatest [[stealth game]]s of all time.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The top 100 PC games |url=https://www.pcgamer.com/top-100-pc-games-2021 |language=en |website=PC Gamer |access-date=22 September 2022 |archive-date=22 September 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220922150342/https://www.pcgamer.com/top-100-pc-games-2021/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Yaden |first=Joseph |date=10 May 2021 |title=The Best Stealth Games of All Time |url=https://www.digitaltrends.com/gaming/the-best-stealth-games-of-all-time/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025433/https://www.digitaltrends.com/gaming/the-best-stealth-games-of-all-time/ |archive-date=11 January 2023 |access-date=19 April 2022 |website=[[Digital Trends]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |author1=Avard |first=Alex |date=25 February 2022 |others=Contributions from Joe Donnelly |title=The best stealth games you can sneak through right now |url=https://www.gamesradar.com/uk/best-stealth-games/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221226051104/http://www.gamesradar.com/best-stealth-games/ |archive-date=26 December 2022 |access-date=15 June 2022 |website=[[GamesRadar+]] |language=en}}</ref> The game was praised for its gameplay loop, creativity, and level design. It was the best-reviewed game in the series.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamesindustry.biz/hitman-3-critical-consensus|title=Hitman 3: Critical Consensus|first=Matthew|last=Handrahan|work=[[Gameindustry.biz]]|date=20 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=2 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230702035722/https://www.gamesindustry.biz/hitman-3-critical-consensus|url-status=live}}</ref>

Nick Statt from ''[[The Verge]]'' praised ''Hitman 3'' for being a cohesive and accessible experience, stating that "IOI has meticulously crafted ways to teach even the most bumbling, haphazard players how to become Agent 47 in mind and body". He compared the game's levels to puzzles, writing that often invites players to understand its gameplay systems and exploit them in order to find success. He praised the game for allowing players to experiment with different approaches, making ''Hitman 3'' a "memorable and darkly comedic experience".<ref name="verge">{{cite web|url=https://www.theverge.com/22252511/hitman-3-review-io-interactive-accessible-storytelling-end-series|title=Hitman 3 has perfected the art of turning bumbling players into master assassins|first=Nick|last=Statt|work=[[The Verge]]|date=28 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=19 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220419035046/https://www.theverge.com/22252511/hitman-3-review-io-interactive-accessible-storytelling-end-series|url-status=live}}</ref> Edwin Evans-Thirlwell from ''[[Eurogamer]]'' wrote that ''Hitman 3'' was most rewarding when observing the patterns of the game's systems and strategising novel plans, although he was disappointed that it does not react to the player's actions in a significant way after a target has been killed.<ref name="EuroGRev"/> While Jeff Cork from ''[[Game Informer]]'' liked the slow pacing and approach to level design, he felt that ''Hitman 3'' was unlikely to convince players unimpressed with previous games.<ref name="GIRev"/> Luke Reily, writing for ''[[IGN]]'', wrote that "the slow-burn thrill of these games comes from planning, patience, and hiding in plain sight", and the game "rewards rational thinking over rushing", while accommodating players who enjoy more action-packed games.<ref name="IGNRev"/> Russ Frushtick from ''[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]]'' wrote that ''Hitman 3'' frequently contrasted "predictable assassin-y stuff with true nonsense", and that the pairing of both seriousness and absurdity resulted in "high comedy".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.polygon.com/22834929/hitman-3-game-of-the-year-dead-goty-parrot-monty-python|title=Hitman 3 is absurd and hilarious, like trying to return a dead parrot|first=Russ|last=Frushtick|website=[[Polygon (website)|Polygon]] |date=15 December 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065540/https://www.polygon.com/22834929/hitman-3-game-of-the-year-dead-goty-parrot-monty-python|url-status=live}}</ref>

[[File:Hitman 3 Dartmoor screenshot.jpg|thumb|left|Some critics compared the Dartmoor level, which features an optional [[murder-mystery]], to the film ''[[Knives Out]]''.]]
The game's level design received critical praise. Writing for ''[[The Guardian]]'', Keith Stuart said that IO had successfully created several intricate locations for players to explore. He enjoyed the openness of each level, and wrote that modern ''Hitman'' games have become hugely replayable and "a benchmark for generous sandbox game design".<ref name="TGRev">{{cite web|url=https://www.theguardian.com/games/2021/jan/22/hitman-3-review-a-wild-bacchanalian-backdrop-to-bloody-escapades|title=Hitman 3 review – a wild bacchanalian backdrop to bloody escapades|first=Keith|last=Stuart|work=[[The Guardian]]|date=22 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=11 January 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025435/https://www.theguardian.com/games/2021/jan/22/hitman-3-review-a-wild-bacchanalian-backdrop-to-bloody-escapades|url-status=live}}</ref> Evans-Thirlwell said that ''Hitman 3''{{'}}s maps were comparable in quality to its predecessors, and said that they were worth revisiting for their diverse assassination opportunities and side stories.<ref name="EuroGRev"/> Hurley praised the incidental events featured, which helped flesh out the game world. Reily wrote that the maps in ''Hitman 3'' were among the best IO had created, praising each location's complex layout and verticality and the wealth of assassination opportunities within them.<ref name="IGNRev"/> Jeff Cork from ''[[Game Informer]]'' praised the levels for their consistent quality, and noted that despite the fixed gameplay loop, IO Interactive was able to introduce variety to mission design. He wrote that each level offered improvisational opportunities for players to approach their objectives.<ref name="GIRev"/> ''[[GameSpot]]''{{'}}s Phil Hornshaw wrote that ''Hitman 3'' was "full of fun and fascinating ideas". He also said that although the gameplay mechanics were similar to the earlier games in the trilogy, the game "finds new ways to challenge seasoned assassins purely through excellent design".<ref name="GSpotRev"/> The Berlin level, which twisted the gameplay formula significantly, received critical acclaim.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-berlin-level-is-the-games-creative-carnage-at-its-very-best/1100-6498916/|title=Best Of 2021: Hitman 3's Berlin Level Is The Game's Creative Carnage At Its Very Best|first=Darryn|last=Bonthyus|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=24 December 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=17 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417154333/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-berlin-level-is-the-games-creative-carnage-at-its-very-best/1100-6498916/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/the-astonishing-berlin-level-in-hitman-3-is-a-landmark-in-the-series/|title=The Astonishing Berlin Level in 'Hitman 3' Is a Landmark in the Series|first=Cameron|last=Kunzelman|work=[[Vice (magazine)|Vice]]|date=2 February 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=1 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230701065558/https://www.vice.com/en/article/88aekv/the-astonishing-berlin-level-in-hitman-3-is-a-landmark-in-the-series|url-status=live}}</ref> Jeff Grubb from ''[[VentureBeat]]'' wrote that Berlin demonstrated the "maturity of the ''Hitman'' formula", remarking that IO Interactive no longer need to rely on mission stories to guide players, allowing players to enjoy a freeform experience.<ref name="VBRev"/> The Dartmoor map was particularly praised for the optional murder mystery elements,<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3-feels-like-a-well-deserved-victory-lap-for-ios-series|title=Hitman 3 feels like a well-deserved victory lap for IO's series|first=Martin|last=Robinson|work=[[Eurogamer]]|date=8 January 2021|accessdate=18 November 2023|archive-date=28 November 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231128232042/https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3-feels-like-a-well-deserved-victory-lap-for-ios-series|url-status=live}}</ref> drawing comparisons to the film ''[[Knives Out]]''.<ref name="GSpotRev"/><ref name="GRadarRev"/><ref name="GZRev"/><ref>{{Cite news |last=Bell |first=Alice |date=8 January 2021 |title=Hitman 3's murder mystery parody level is the most fun I've had playing Hitman |language=en |work=[[Rock Paper Shotgun]] |url=https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/hitman-3s-murder-mystery-parody-level-is-the-most-fun-ive-had-playing-hitman |access-date=17 April 2022 |archive-date=6 August 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210806173549/https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/hitman-3s-murder-mystery-parody-level-is-the-most-fun-ive-had-playing-hitman |url-status=live }}</ref> The final level, set on a train in the [[Carpathian Mountains]], was criticised for its linearity and as feeling out of place for a ''Hitman'' game.<ref name="EuroGRev"/><ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://www.wired.com/review/hitman-3/|title=Review: Hitman 3 Is a Beautifully Executed Finale|first=Simon|last=Hill|magazine=[[Wired (magazine)|Wired]]|date=29 April 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=17 April 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417173504/https://www.wired.com/review/hitman-3/|url-status=live}}</ref>

The narrative received mixed reviews from critics. Slatt enjoyed the larger emphasis on the game's story. He wrote that the game had successfully combined the engrossing story found in ''[[Hitman Absolution]]'' and the freeform gameplay found in ''[[Hitman: Blood Money]]''. He stated that the stronger story in the game gave players a more clear purpose in assassinating various targets. He also praised IOI for making individual missions more story-driven.<ref name="verge"/> Hornshaw praised the game for tying the targets to the game's story, resulting in more interesting characters and consequential missions.<ref name="GSpotRev"/> Writing for ''[[VG 247]]'', Alex Donaldson stated that the experience was more "directed", and that IO's attempt to turn ''Hitman 3'' into an "epic story" largely succeeded, noting that it was significantly less silly than its predecessors.<ref name="VG247Rev"/> Hurley also felt that the game "has a stronger narrative flow to locations and story beats". Stuart, however, found the story to be forgettable and formulaic, especially in comparison with the emergent stories that the player can create on their own. He likened the game's narrative to "straight-to-[[Netflix]] spy thrillers".<ref name="TGRev"/> Cameron Kunzelman from ''[[Vice (magazine)|Vice]]'' criticised the game for being story-driven. Following the failure of ''Absolution'' in 2012, he wrote that the franchise was again repeating its mistake.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vice.com/en/article/hitman-3-review/|title='Hitman 3' Loses Its Identity as It Goes All-In on Story|first=Cameron|last=Kunzelman|work=[[Vice (magazine)|Vice]]|date=19 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=12 May 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230512105411/https://www.vice.com/en/article/dy85gm/hitman-3-review|url-status=live}}</ref>

The PlayStation VR mode received mostly positive reviews and was praised for its immersion, impressive visuals for a PSVR title and for supporting all of the maps in the trilogy. It was criticised for visual downgrades, including a lack of [[Reflection (computer graphics)|reflections]] and low [[draw distance]]. The control scheme, which utilises a combination of [[DualShock|DualShock 4]] controller and motion controls, received mixed reviews.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Feltham |first=Jamie |date=19 January 2021 |title=Hitman 3 VR Review - A (Mostly) Clean Kill |url=https://uploadvr.com/hitman-3-vr-review/ |access-date=17 April 2022 |website=[[UploadVR]] |language=en-US |archive-date=21 August 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220821104926/https://uploadvr.com/hitman-3-vr-review/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |last=Higton |first=Ian |date=20 January 2021 |title=Hitman VR - the verdict |language=en-gb |work=[[Eurogamer]] |url=https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3-vr-is-more-of-a-hit-than-a-miss-on-psvr |access-date=17 April 2022 |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417173504/https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3-vr-is-more-of-a-hit-than-a-miss-on-psvr |url-status=live }}</ref> The PC VR version released in 2022 was heavily criticised for not offering full motion controls or improving upon the flaws of the PlayStation version.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Higton |first=Ian |date=23 January 2022 |title=Hitman 3's PC VR support disappoints in almost every department |language=en-gb |work=[[Eurogamer]] |url=https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3s-pc-vr-support-disappoints-in-almost-every-department |access-date=17 April 2022 |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417173511/https://www.eurogamer.net/hitman-3s-pc-vr-support-disappoints-in-almost-every-department |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Feltham |first=Jamie |date=20 January 2022 |title=Hitman 3's PC VR Support Is Pretty Janky Right Now |url=https://uploadvr.com/hitman-3s-pc-vr-support-janky/ |access-date=17 April 2022 |website=[[UploadVR]] |language=en-US |archive-date=17 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220417174124/https://uploadvr.com/hitman-3s-pc-vr-support-janky/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== Sales ===
''Hitman 3'' reached number one on the UK game boxed charts, with launch sales up by 17% over ''Hitman 2''.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Dring |first=Christopher |date=24 January 2021 |title=Hitman 3 surpasses its predecessor to claim No.1 &#124; UK Boxed Charts |url=https://www.gamesindustry.biz/articles/2021-01-24-hitman-3-surpasses-its-predecessor-to-claim-no-1-uk-boxed-charts |website= |publisher=[[GamesIndustry.biz]] |access-date=31 January 2021 |archive-date=30 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210130055750/https://www.gamesindustry.biz/articles/2021-01-24-hitman-3-surpasses-its-predecessor-to-claim-no-1-uk-boxed-charts |url-status=live }}</ref> IO Interactive stated that ''Hitman 3'' had the "biggest digital launch" for the franchise.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-has-strong-start-sets-new-digital-sales-record/1100-6486619/|title=Hitman 3 Has Strong Start, Sets New Digital Sales Record|first=Eddie|last=Makuch|work=[[GameSpot]]|date=22 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=4 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230604013509/https://www.gamespot.com/articles/hitman-3-has-strong-start-sets-new-digital-sales-record/1100-6486619/|url-status=live}}</ref> A week after the game's release, ''Hitman 3''{{'}}s sales had surpassed its development budget.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-profitable|title=Hitman 3 is already profitable, recoups total project costs in less than a week|first=Stephanny|last=Nunneley-Jackson|date=27 January 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|work=[[VG247]]|archive-date=7 July 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230707101203/https://www.vg247.com/hitman-3-profitable|url-status=live}}</ref> By April 2021, IO Interactive CEO Hakan Abrak stated that ''Hitman 3'' had performed "300% better commercially" than ''Hitman 2''.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gamingbolt.com/hitman-3-sold-300-better-than-previous-game|title=Hitman 3 Sold 300% Better Than Previous Game|first=Landon|last=Wright|date=16 April 2021|access-date=2 August 2023|archive-date=7 December 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221207110450/https://gamingbolt.com/hitman-3-sold-300-better-than-previous-game|url-status=live}}</ref> By November 2021, ''Hitman 3'' had become the most successful entry of the ''World of Assassination'' trilogy and the series as a whole, reaching 50 million players.<ref name=":14">{{Cite news |date=22 November 2021 |title=HITMAN 3 - Year 2 Announcement |newspaper=[[IO Interactive]] |url=https://www.ioi.dk/hitman-3-year-2/ |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230111025448/https://www.ioi.dk/hitman-3-year-2/ |archive-date=11 January 2023}}</ref> By December 2025, the trilogy had sold over 25 million units.<ref name=":4" />

==Future==
In an interview conducted by ''Variety'' in December 2025, IO's CEO Hakan Abrak confirmed that after the studio shares additional information about a new co-op mode for the ''World of Assassination'' trilogy, it will begin unveiling information on the next ''Hitman'' game.<ref name=":4"> {{Cite web |last=Maas |first=Jennifer |date=1 December 2025 |title=As 'Hitman' Turns 25, IO Interactive CEO Talks Eminem-Slim Shady Collab, '007 First Light' Inspiration and Future of the Video Game Franchise: 'Of Course There's Going to Be' a 'Hitman 4' |url=https://variety.com/2025/gaming/news/hitman-eminem-slim-shady-mission-io-interactive-ceo-interview-1236595901/ |access-date=25 December 2025 |website=Variety |language=en-US}}</ref>
